theorems.name: Submission.ecf_cp_gc_det_smul
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (w : Fin k → Euclid P) (t : ℝ), Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ ((Fin.cons a (t • w) : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) i) ((Fin.cons a (t • w) : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) j)) = (t ^ k) ^ 2 * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ ((Fin.cons a w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) i) ((Fin.cons a w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) j))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
